unit_configs.name: prefill-0
unit_configs.cmd:
SCRIPT_PATH=/workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts

export PYTHONHASHSEED=1234
export log_level_proxy=info
export core_num=4
export start_core_index=16
export pd_policy=sequential

TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 bash "${SCRIPT_PATH}/proxy.sh" \
  --subrequest-output-buffer-size 10M \
  --omni-proxy-pd-policy sequential \
  --omni-proxy-schedule-algo header_affinity \
  --omni-proxy-affinity-header X-Session-Id \
  --omni-proxy-max-batch-num-token 300000 \
  --omni-proxy-prefill-max-num-seqs 12 \
  --omni-proxy-decode-max-num-seqs 8 &&

export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=2
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=100
export gpu_util=0.92
export max_num_seqs=12
export max_num_batched_tokens=32768
export OMNI_CUSTOM_MODEL_CONFIG_PATH="low_latency/openpangu_v2/pangu_v2_moe_bf16_a3_92B_xp1d_p_open.json"
export kv_transfer_config='{"kv_buffer_device":"npu","kv_connector":"LLMDataDistConnector","kv_parallel_size":1,"kv_role":"kv_producer","kv_rank":0}'

bash "${SCRIPT_PATH}/prefill.sh"  --block-size 128 \
  --mamba-block-size 128 \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --max-model-len 524288 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 \
  --max-num-seqs 12 \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --enforce-eager \
  --no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager \
  --reasoning-parser pangu \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --tool-call-parser pangu \
  --enable-prompt-tokens-details \
  --enable-lopt \
  --lopt-pool-size 16 \
  --lopt-chunk-size 4096 \
  --reasoning-config '{"reasoning_start_str":"<think>","reasoning_end_str":"</think>","ban_sequence_end_in_thinking":true}' \
  --additional-config '{"enable_low_latency":true}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' && sleep infinity

unit_configs.name: decode
unit_configs.cmd:
SCRIPT_PATH=/workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts

unset TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD

export PYTHONHASHSEED=1234
export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1200
export gpu_util=0.85
export max_num_seqs=8
export max_num_batched_tokens=2048
export ENABLE_DP_LB=false
export tp=1
export NUM_SERVERS=8
export VLLM_DATA_PARALLEL_EXTERNAL_LB=false
export VLLM_CACHE_ROOT="./graph_cache"
export VLLM_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1
export OMNI_CUSTOM_MODEL_CONFIG_PATH="low_latency/openpangu_v2/pangu_v2_moe_bf16_a3_92B_xp1d_d_open.json"
export kv_transfer_config='{"kv_buffer_device":"npu","kv_connector":"LLMDataDistConnector","kv_parallel_size":1,"kv_role":"kv_consumer","kv_rank":0}'

bash "${SCRIPT_PATH}/decode.sh"  --block-size 128 \
  --mamba-block-size 128 \
  --enable-prefix-caching \
  --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --max-model-len 524288 \
  --max-num-seqs 8 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 2048 \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager \
  --compilation-config '{"mode":3,"cudagraph_mode":"FULL","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[32],"backend":"","compile_sizes":[32]}' \
  --reasoning-parser pangu \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --tool-call-parser pangu \
  --enable-prompt-tokens-details \
  --enable-lopt \
  --lopt-pool-size 16 \
  --lopt-chunk-size 4096 \
  --reasoning-config '{"reasoning_start_str":"<think>","reasoning_end_str":"</think>","ban_sequence_end_in_thinking":true}' \
  --additional-config '{"enable_low_latency":true,"npugraph_ex_config":{"enable":true,"super_kernel_optimize":false,"static_kernel_compile":false}}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' && sleep infinity
